title: PSYCH101: Introduction to Psychology
reason: Substantial 46-hour psychology foundation covering research methods, emotion, development, memory and psychopathology with a free final exam and certificate.

title: Introduction to Psychology
reason: MIT survey of human behaviour and mental life with lecture audio, notes, written assignments and exams spanning biological, cognitive and social perspectives.
notes: Archive course from 2004; deep review must compare dated examples and science with current alternatives.

title: Forensic psychology
reason: Eight-week applied psychology course on eyewitness cognition and miscarriages of justice with weekly quizzes, a free badge and statement of participation.

title: Psychology around the world
reason: Cross-cultural psychology course examining thoughts, emotions and behaviour across societies, providing a useful corrective to overly Western introductory curricula.

title: Investigating psychology
reason: Intermediate course on psychological questions, research methods, competing perspectives and the historical and social context of psychological enquiry.

title: Starting with psychology
reason: Accessible introduction to how psychologists explain thought, emotion and behaviour, with exercises and a free statement of participation.

title: Saúde Mental e Bem-Estar no Ensino Superior
reason: Portuguese course covering mental-health concepts, stress, coping, resilience and first-response support with module assessments and a completion certificate.

title: Introduction to child psychology
reason: Eight-hour introduction to developmental theories, research questions and applied child psychology with activities and a free statement of participation.
notes: Core theory is stable, but the course was first published in 2014 and should be checked for research currency.

title: Competência digital docente: avaliação pedagógica
reason: Twenty-seven-hour Portuguese teacher-development course on digital assessment, with online activities, final evaluation and a free completion certificate.

title: Take your teaching online
reason: Twenty-four-hour badged course from a distance-learning specialist on effective, inclusive online teaching, tool selection, pedagogy and evaluation with CPD recognition.

title: Teaching and learning tricky topics
reason: Twenty-four-hour badged course focused on difficult concepts, learner misconceptions and teaching strategies, with quizzes and a free Open University digital badge.

title: TeachingEnglish: Understanding language systems
reason: Current free teacher-development course on functional language, grammar and classroom presentation, with workbook, self-study modules and completion certificate.

title: Developing students' AI literacy
reason: New 2026 teacher course on AI-literacy frameworks, ethics, curriculum integration and assessment, with practical action planning for classroom use.
notes: The official page exposes a Join course flow; free-access and credential mechanics require shallow verification.

title: CiberSegurança nas Escolas
reason: Portuguese school-focused cybersecurity course covering threats, cybercrime and institutional practice, with a free completion certificate and digital seal.

title: Apprenez à apprendre
reason: Freshly updated six-hour French course on learning strategy, memory, self-directed planning and study habits with quizzes and practical exercises.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Human Rights
reason: Updated human-rights course aligned with current European AI legal instruments, using interactive material, knowledge tests and reflective exercises with a free statement of accomplishment.

title: Cybercrime and Electronic Evidence
language_notes: Available in self-learning format in at least 13 languages according to the official course announcement.
reason: Ten-hour legal course on cybercrime, electronic evidence and the Budapest Convention, available for self-learning with an electronic statement of accomplishment.

title: Data Protection and Privacy Rights

title: Introduction to the ECHR and the ECtHR
reason: Core Council of Europe self-learning course explaining the European Convention on Human Rights, the Court and execution of judgments, with free completion recognition.

title: Freedom of Expression
reason: Approximately nine-hour Article 10 course with four substantive modules, quizzes and a free electronic HELP statement of accomplishment.

title: Protection and Safety of Journalists
language_notes: English plus multiple translated versions; exact currently available language list must be normalised during shallow review.
reason: Ten-hour course on legal standards, threats, state obligations and mechanisms protecting journalists, with self-learning access and an electronic statement of accomplishment.

title: Direitos e deveres no digital
language_notes: Official page lists Portuguese and English.
reason: Current Portuguese digital-citizenship course covering EU rights, data protection, expression, online ethics, fraud and cyberbullying with mandatory tests.

title: Consumidor Ciberseguro
reason: Practical Portuguese course on safer online shopping, payment methods, fraud and EU consumer rights with assessed activities and a completion certificate.

title: BUS402: Introduction to Project Management
reason: Fifty-two-hour project-management foundation covering initiation through closure, PMI-style process groups and people skills, with free assessment and certificate.

title: PRDV224: Leadership and Teams
reason: Nine-hour management course on leadership, influence, team formation, collaboration and conflict, with free final exam and course certificate.

title: PRDV228: Decision-Making

title: PRDV231: Elements of Ethical Leadership

title: Gestão de vendas

provider: Escola Superior de Enfermagem do Porto / NAU
reason: Twenty-hour Portuguese population-health course with videos, quizzes and final assessment spanning determinants, policy, diversity, prevention and digital health, awarding two ECTS.
